factor_base_policy: exact cofactor-four projected type-II normal-basis x weight at most six
direct_scan_rule: For each selected first pair, scan both signs of every factor-base point for each of four complements; use the Q1502 paired-sign batch kernel with 512 x-coordinate pairs per batch.
rank_supply_rule: Reuse Q1414 fixed-count uniform-nonidentity query bounds; compute the cost of one complete four-sign scan for each required query. Early stops and guided target laws are outside this arithmetic scenario.
